X13-04.name: The LionMachineArmorDeity Walhalance-Leo
X13-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Green/White/Yellow]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green/White/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh a Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Battles)
By exhausting a White Spirit you control, this Spirit gains +(BP of the exhausted Spirit) BP.

X13-05.name: The StarAngelia Mikarean
X13-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave ignoring brave conditions.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a Magic card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

X13-01.name: The SunDino Apollo-Gundinos
X13-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. When a Spirit is destroyed by this effect, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit.
